Refactored the long sorter to make the internal buffering clearer and cheaper across digit passes.

What changed:
- [`LongRadixSort.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/038_radix_sort/src/radixsort/LongRadixSort.java#L32) no longer uses a nested workspace class.
- The digit-pass scratch buffers are now explicit local arrays reused across passes, which makes the flow easier to follow and avoids the extra abstraction layer.
- `sort(...)` now clones and sorts directly, while `sortedCopy(...)` retains the non-mutating API.

The overall structure remains:
- [`RadixSort.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/038_radix_sort/src/radixsort/RadixSort.java#L19) orchestrates the public API.
- [`IntPartitions.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/038_radix_sort/src/radixsort/IntPartitions.java#L12) handles sign partitioning and merging.
- [`LongRadixSort.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/038_radix_sort/src/radixsort/LongRadixSort.java#L5) owns the radix/counting sort mechanics.
